newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai port container tonnage up 31 pct in H1 97.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai port container tonnage up 31 pct in H1 97.

text.p: SHANGHAI, Aug 3 (reuter) - Shanghai's port handled 1.12 million tonnes of containers in the first half of 1997, a year-on-year increase of 31 percent, the official Xinhua news agency said.
That figure was expected to rise to a total of 2.3 million tonnes for the year, Xinhua quoted the city's port authorities as saying.

Imports through Shanghai's port in the first half of 1997 totalled 14.2 million tonnes, up 7.5 percent compared with the same 1996 period, with exports rising 22.8 percent to 8.3 million tonnes, Xinhua said in a late Saturday despatch.
In 1996, Shanghai port handled nearly two million tonnes of containers, making it the 17th-biggest port in the world, Xinhua said.
